missing_lines: All 38 lines contain inline maths or belong to display equations (6) and (7), now written in LaTeX (e.g. 'gV (xNT ) = V (xNT , bℓNT ) −V (x0, ℓ0)', '4e−4, 4e−4, 1.1e−2, 1e−1, 5.6e−3', 'of vmax · Nt · ∆t along the path'). Each line was read on 250-dpi crops (left column y 50-740, right column y 440-740); the prose words around the maths match the page and sim_experiments.tex/approach.tex, and a word-level script check flagged only tokens that are inside formulas (xNT, diag, rad, tan, vmax, and the numbers 0.33, 0.1, 1024, 0.05, 0.35, 0.01, 0.4, 1.1, 5.6, which are present inside $...$).
number_differences: Two causes, both notation only. (1) Scientific notation in Gamma and Q: the PDF text layer gives '4e−4' (x2), '1.1e−2', '1e−1', '5.6e−3', '1e−2' (x2) as single tokens, the LaTeX writes $4\mathrm{e}^{-4}$ etc., which the tokenizer reads as mantissa and exponent separately ('4','-4','1.1','-2','1','-1','5.6','-3','1','-2','1','-2'). (2) U+2212 versus ASCII minus in the interval bounds '[−1., 1]', '[−1, 1]', '[−1, 3]' and '[−0.4, 0.4]'. Every number was compared with the page image: 4e-4, 4e-4, 1.1e-2, 1e-1, 5.6e-3; 1e-2, 1e-2, 0, 0, 0; -1., 1; -1, 1; -0.4, 0.4; -1, 3; 0.33; 12; 0.1; 0.2; 50Hz (x2); 5; 1024; 0.05; 2; 4; 0.35; 0.01; [53], [54]; tags (6), (7).
independent_parser_number_differences: Same two causes as number_differences; in addition the second parser splits the '0.1' of '∆t = 0.1' into '0' and '1' (hence missing '0', extra '0.1' and one fewer extra '1'). The page prints 0.1, as transcribed.
